audit.why: Brand owns levels 1-2 (Sear stun + Pillar burst before Viktor has E), skill mid-lane, Viktor wins from two items. 54.86% WR over 2904 games backs the scaling read.
Spikes structure right: Brand early window, even at 6 (both ults positional), Viktor at 2+ items. Matches packet levelChart Brand/Brand/Skill x4/Viktor.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' is a fabricated name for Viktor's E in whys[2], spikes[0].text, mid, and wants.foe[1] — real name is Hextech Ray. Cooldowns field has no digit.
audit.why: Kit E text: 'fire a Hextech Ray'. Brand Q 8s rank 1 / 6s max, W 10s early, R 100s; Viktor W 17s.
audit.corrected: All four renames plus numbered cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[0].side and phases[1].side read 'Skill' while content win[0]/win[1] read 'Brand'.
audit.why: Content and packet levelChart agree Brand wins levels 1-2; full layer disagrees. Side edits alone per chart rule (win[N] already correct), whys and ratings rewritten to match.
audit.corrected: Two side flips with matching why/rating.

edits.before: By level 3 your Death Ray matches his poke range and trades even out.
edits.after: By level 3 your Hextech Ray matches his poke range and trades even out.

edits.before: Brand's early kill pressure is real: a landed Q (Sear) stun into W (Pillar of Flame) chunks a third of your HP before you have E to answer. Play the wave for last-hits, dodge his skillshot Q, and don't walk into the stun. Trades even out once your Death Ray matches his poke range.
edits.after: Brand's early kill pressure is real: a landed Q (Sear) stun into W (Pillar of Flame) chunks a third of your HP before you have E to answer. Play the wave for last-hits, dodge his skillshot Q, and don't walk into the stun. Trades even out once your Hextech Ray matches his poke range.

edits.before: From level 3 it levels out into a skillshot duel: your Death Ray matches his Pillar-of-Flame range, and whoever dodges better wins each exchange. Level 6 doesn't tilt it either way 1v1, since your slow Chaos Storm zone and his bounce-dependent ult both need good positioning to matter. Keep dodging his Q and shove for plates when he steps back.
edits.after: From level 3 it levels out into a skillshot duel: your Hextech Ray matches his Pillar-of-Flame range, and whoever dodges better wins each exchange. Level 6 doesn't tilt it either way 1v1, since your slow Chaos Storm zone and his bounce-dependent ult both need good positioning to matter. Keep dodging his Q and shove for plates when he steps back.

edits.before: Abuse his level 1-2 burst before your Death Ray comes online
edits.after: Abuse his level 1-2 burst before your Hextech Ray comes online

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking ablaze, landing the Sear stun, and chunking a third of your HP each rotation.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - W Gravity Field spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Brand Sear: 8s at rank 1, 6s maxed — it only stuns when you are ablaze, so after eating W or E the stun line is the dodge that matters. - Pillar of Flame runs 10s early — his shove and poke both live on it. - Your W is 17s; his R is 100s — hold yours for his commit.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Drop Gravity Field where he must stand to combo — Pillar wants him stationary, and the slow-then-stun flips his engage into your kill.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces up to five times and stacks his ablaze passive — at half HP one combo with R deletes you from range.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: Brand wins level 1: his Sear-into-Pillar burst can nearly kill you before you have any answer — take last-hits.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: Still Brand's: his passive and Pillar damage out-trade you with no E answer yet. Dodge Sear and farm safe.
